VR.title: Xreal's new $299 AR glasses bring the big-screen experience to more people
VR.summary: Xreal's new $299 a01+ AR glasses launch in the U.S., offering a 147-inch virtual screen and lightweight design for an affordable big-screen experience.

VR.title: Ghosts of Tabor: Legacy Returns The Shooter To Its 2024 Era Later This Month
VR.summary: Combat Waffle Studios announces Ghosts of Tabor: Legacy, a new title restoring the 2024 version of the game for Meta Quest and PC VR.

VR.title: Apple Publishes Detailed Technical Specifications for Third-party Vision Pro Motion Controllers
VR.summary: Apple publishes technical specifications for third-party motion controllers compatible with its Vision Pro headset, enhancing developer opportunities.

VR.title: John Carmack Reminds Microsoft He'll Guarantee $1 Million To Bring Team Beef’s Ports To VR
VR.summary: John Carmack reiterates his $1 million guarantee to bring Team Beef’s VR ports of classic id Software games to fruition.

VR.title: Meta Reaffirms "Multiple Next-Generation Headsets", Hints At Connect Announcement
VR.summary: Meta's CTO confirms ongoing development of multiple next-generation headsets, hinting at a potential reveal at the upcoming Connect event.

VR.title: VR/MR Puzzler Squingle Arcade Is Out Today On Meta Quest For Free
VR.summary: Squingle Arcade, a new VR/MR puzzle game featuring hand tracking, is now available for free on Meta Quest.

AI.title: Apple sues OpenAI for allegedly stealing hardware secrets
AI.summary: Apple has sued OpenAI, alleging theft of trade secrets related to hardware development by former Apple engineers.

AI.title: Google will now tell you if an ad was made with AI
AI.summary: Google introduces a new feature to label ads created or edited with AI across its platforms, enhancing transparency for users.

AI.title: Meta turns off the Instagram feature that let users make AI deepfakes of public accounts
AI.summary: Meta disables an Instagram feature that allowed users to create AI deepfakes of public accounts following public backlash.

AI.title: Apple’s failed self-driving car program left a legacy of powerful AI chips
AI.summary: Apple's failed self-driving car project has inadvertently led to the development of powerful AI chips for its devices.

AI.title: Would you host part of an AI data center in your home?
AI.summary: Sunrun launches a pilot program to host AI data centers in customers' homes, incentivizing participation with financial compensation.

AI.title: The ChatGPT browser is already dead
AI.summary: OpenAI announces the shutdown of ChatGPT Atlas, its browser tool, less than a year after its launch.

NFL.title: Vinod Khosla-led group agrees to buy the Seahawks for a reported $9.612 billion
NFL.summary: Vinod Khosla's group agrees to purchase the Seattle Seahawks for a reported $9.612 billion, marking a significant NFL transaction.

NFL.title: Aaron Rodgers can become the fifth quarterback in NFL history with 70,000 passing yards
NFL.summary: Aaron Rodgers aims to become the fifth quarterback in NFL history to achieve 70,000 passing yards in his final season.

NFL.title: Vinod Khosla "excited" to see all money from his Seahawks purchase "go to a non-profit"
NFL.summary: Vinod Khosla expresses excitement about his Seahawks purchase, stating all profits will benefit a non-profit organization.

NFL.title: Bears sign third-round TE Sam Roush to complete draft class signings
NFL.summary: The Bears complete their draft class signings by officially signing third-round tight end Sam Roush.

NFL.title: Report: Aaron Donald works out at Rams' facility
NFL.summary: Aaron Donald is spotted working out at the Rams' facility, fueling speculation about a potential return from retirement.

NFL.title: ESPN places Matt Miller on leave
NFL.summary: ESPN places NFL draft analyst Matt Miller on leave following a serious car accident and subsequent online complaints.
